name: Al Azif
source: [spoiler]One of the Elder Gods duo from True End of Al Azif's route and real mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c12695]Daijuuji Kuzaku[/url]. After ascended into same domain as Outer God [url=https://vndb.org/c935]Nyarlathotep[/url], she along with her husband Elder God [url=https://vndb.org/c96255]Daijuuji Kurou[/url] have went an unending battle against the Evil Gods including [url=https://vndb.org/c935]Nya[/url] herself, thus becoming her biggest arch nemesis. Prior to the story of [url=https://vndb.org/v234]Kishin Hishou[/url], they gave birth to [url=https://vndb.org/c12695]Kuzaku[/url], however deeming that their own child can not live together with them as they have chosen the path to fight against evil endlessly, they asked Dunsany to take care of the infant [url=https://vndb.org/c12695]Kuzaku[/url] and their Demonbane to perform one last mission: Send him back to the human world.[/spoiler]
